description: A hand-painted moss-green fox-squirrel companion with a huge curled tail, cream chest, alert eyes, black ink contours, and a warm orange nose.

idle.notes: Calm breathing and blink with a settled tail.

walk.notes: True opposite drag-facing gait with the attached tail following.

curious.notes: Focused lean and eye attention without new props.

sleep.notes: Patient expectant pose used for approval or input.

jump.notes: Connected vertical playful jump without effects.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
dragFacingValidation.manualVerification: Both drag rows are true opposite directions and keep Moss Tail's head, paws, torso, and attached tail coherent.
